subject: Q4 Slate: Concord & Runbook - signoff needed
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellen Rios <ellen@fargrind.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 Slate: Concord & Runbook - signoff needed

Team —

Attached is the proposed Q4 slate (v3) and the initial runbook we want to ship alongside the pilot of the StratApp integration. High level:

- Objective A: Reduce inference latency P95 by 20% for pilot traffic (owner: Serving Runtime)
- Objective B: Cut per-token cost for embeddings-heavy routes by 15% via batching + KV cache (owner: Platform)
- Objective C: Launch StratApp pilot with dedicated routing and audit logging (owner: Partnerships)

Key asks: please review and reply with "signoff" or a one-sentence blocker by end-of-day Monday, Sep 13. If you have edits to the runbook, add comments in the attached spreadsheet.

Attachments: q4_slate_v3.pdf (slide summary), runbook_playbook_v2.xlsx (playbook draft).

Links: runbook and supporting tickets in the header.

Thanks — I will consolidate responses and send the final roll-forward plan on Tuesday.

Connor O'Brien
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference


From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 Slate: Concord & Runbook - signoff needed

On Fri, Sep 11, 2026 at 9:12 AM Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Attached is the proposed Q4 slate (v3) and the initial runbook we want to ship alongside the pilot of the StratApp integration.

Thanks — reviewed slides quickly. Two small asks before I can sign:

1) Objective B metric looks like a mix of embedding and generation cost. Can we split the measurement so we don’t mask generation regressions? Suggest adding a secondary metric: embedding cost/unit and gen cost/unit.
2) Under Objective C, add an explicit rollback window and customer notification cadence (legal asked for this during discovery).

I can sign off after those two are clarified — happy to take the second bullet and draft the notification cadence if helpful.

Hannah
VP, Growth & GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 08:40:00 -0700

On Fri, Sep 11, 2026 at 11:05 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks — reviewed slides quickly. Two small asks before I can sign:

Thanks for the notes — I made two edits in the runbook_playbook_v2.xlsx and attached it here:

- Added a split metric row for embedding vs generation cost under Objective B (tab: Metrics).
- Added a rollback window and a sample customer notification template under Objective C (tab: Rollback & Comms).

I also added an owners column for the emergency on-call path — please check the names.

Attachment: runbook_playbook_v2.xlsx (updated with comments).

Kimmie
Head of Product, API
Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 Slate: Concord & Runbook - signoff needed

Looks good to me. Approved pending one capacity confirmation: can infra guarantee the burst pool for pilot hours (Nov 2–6)? I’ll loop in infra if needed, but wanted a quick green from product/ops first.

If infra confirms, I’ll sign as well.

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ellen Rios <ellen@fargrind.ai>, Acme Legal <contracts@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 Slate: Concord & Runbook - signoff needed / FINAL

Thanks all — locking this down. Summary of final decisions: 

- Objective B: metrics split implemented (embedding cost/unit; generation cost/unit) — see runbook_metrics tab.
- Objective C: rollback window set to 60 minutes with customer notification template finalized.
- Owners column updated for emergency on-call (Kim, Vivek, Connor) and infra asked to confirm burst pool by Tue Sep 15.

Signoff log: Hannah — signoff; Kimberly — signoff (edits applied); Vivek — provisional signoff pending infra confirmation.

Action items:
- Connor: send roll-forward email and publish runbook to Drive (done).
- Kimberly: follow up with infra to confirm burst capacity and update playbook if needed.
- Hannah: finalize customer notification cadence copy (by Tue EOD).

Connor O'Brien
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: q4_slate_v3.pdf, runbook_playbook_v2.xlsx
